visualCharacteristics.purpose: Choose-one product finder: a question with radio options (optionally illustrated), an option picker that reveals a product detail panel, and a CTA that follows the selected option

contentPattern.structure: Optional first row: one cell with heading and intro text. Optional single-cell text row: the question (legend). Option rows: cell 1 = option label (optional image/icon, text, link to the result page), cell 2 = optional detail panel shown when selected (name, price, included features, CTA). Optional last row: one cell holding only a link, the CTA whose href follows the selected option

reuseGuidance: Use for account/card/GIC finder steps and option pickers with a detail panel. Interactive calculators belong to calculator; slider-only inputs (v_1d73c29c7b5b) are not modelled as option rows and need a design-pass or calculator treatment.
